subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw own FxTwitter as a supported, explicitly opt-in public read provider, including its privacy disclosure and ongoing API-compatibility burden?
rationale: The existing architecture can host another read provider and the proposal broadly follows VISION.md, but accepting dependence on a third-party public service is a product and support commitment that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor a staged MVP
options.body: Approve an explicit-mode provider beginning with post and thread or conversation reads, with a safe configurable endpoint and no automatic fallback.

options.title: Defer provider support
options.body: Keep the proposal available but postpone implementation until service stability, maintenance ownership, or user demand is clearer.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Leave FxTwitter as an external integration idea rather than adding it to Birdclaw's supported provider contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a staged MVP
recommendation.body: Approve an explicit-mode provider beginning with post and thread or conversation reads, with a safe configurable endpoint and no automatic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership, product-vision responsibility, and direct engagement make steipete the best available owner for this provider-support decision.
